ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms obsolete cases, replacement evidence and the delete-live-regression flag are declared; it does not run the suite.
offer: Remove tests only when their behavior is retired or equivalent protection is demonstrated. Age and inconvenience do not make a live regression dead.

minimal.reason: List the tests judged obsolete. Without names nothing is reviewable, so identify each case.

mid.reason: Record the evidence that equivalent protection remains. Age alone does not make a regression dead, so cite the replacement.

maximal.reason: Set deleting live regressions to false. Removing a test that still guards behavior reopens a defect, so keep it.
